author: Prachi Bhardwaj
title: Apple's 'white ring' problem reflects a surprising lapse in quality control, but industrial design experts say it shouldn't be too hard to fix (AAPL)
text: Apple's 'white ring' problem reflects a surprising lapse in quality control, but industrial design experts say it shouldn't be too hard to fix (AAPL) By Prachi Bhardwaj Feb 18, 2018, 9:30 am 28 pts The "white ring" problem that affects Apple HomePods placed on certain kinds of wood furniture is an embarrassing snafu for a company that prides itself on attention to detail. Although the problem relates to the interaction between silicone and wood and does not appear to be Apple-specific, some…
